_comment: Shared TS<->Python parity fixture for availability-aware role resolution (spec docs/spec-model-rungs-and-roles-2026-06-09.md Addendum 3.A). Both ModelRouter.ts (resolveRoleAvailability) and primary_bot.py (resolve_role_with_availability) must resolve each (pod, bot, credentialed) triple to the SAME {model, resolvedRole, degraded, reason} per role. 'credentialed' is the RAW provider set (presence of a usable key); availability intersects it against the LLM-capable set DERIVED from the merged catalog's rung clusters (no provider literal — three-homes rule Addendum 3.B). 'reason' unifies degradation: uncredentialed | unconfigured | same_vendor_as_standard | null. JUDGE DIVERSITY IS A PREFERENCE (2026-06-19): judge prefers a cross-vendor model but falls back to standard's own vendor with reason 'same_vendor_as_standard' (it STILL ROUTES); it is hard-unavailable (model null) only when no credentialed model exists in its rung at all. KEEP IN SYNC: edit once; both parity tests read it.

scenarios.name: fully credentialed pod — every role resolves, no degradation
non-LLM credential only (brave) — every LLM role unavailable
scenarios._comment: brave is credentialed but is NOT in any rung cluster, so the LLM-capable intersection is empty. Every role degrades to the bottom of the ladder and still finds nothing -> unavailable with uncredentialed. judge is off-ladder -> uncredentialed directly.

scenarios.name: only openai credentialed — max degrades down to a credentialed rung
scenarios._comment: fable-class is anthropic-only in defaults, but the enriched opus-class now holds openai/gpt-4.1 (Addendum 7 #13). With only openai credentialed: max degrades max->power; power's opus-class holds openai/gpt-4.1 so max resolves there (resolvedRole=power, degraded, uncredentialed). power itself resolves WITHIN its own opus-class rung to openai/gpt-4.1 (no degradation). standard resolves to openai/gpt-4.1 within sonnet-class. fast resolves to openai/gpt-4.1-mini within haiku-class. judge: standard provider is openai; diversity prefers non-openai but the only credentialed provider IS openai -> judge falls back to openai/gpt-4.1 (same vendor) and STILL ROUTES with reason same_vendor_as_standard (diversity is a preference, not a requirement).

scenarios.name: within-rung credentialed fallback preferred over degradation
scenarios._comment: pod gives power's opus-class a two-provider cluster [anthropic, openai]; only openai credentialed. power resolves WITHIN its own rung to the openai member (no degradation) rather than degrading to standard.

scenarios.name: anthropic-only pod — every role resolves to anthropic, judge routes same-vendor with advisory
scenarios._comment: This is evo's live shape (the bug this fix targets). judge diversity prefers a provider != standard's anthropic; the default judge rung (sonnet-class) holds non-anthropic options (openai/gpt-4.1, google/gemini-2.5-pro, xai/grok-4) but NONE are credentialed -> judge falls back to anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6 (same vendor as standard) and STILL ROUTES with reason same_vendor_as_standard. It is NOT a hard break; the UI surfaces a soft amber advisory.
